purpose: Teach: 改ざん/急騰/募る/整然と/名著/同好/真下/アーム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 書類、本気で、絶対、改ざん、絶対、絶対、許さんぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Document falsification—absolutely, completely unacceptable. I'm serious. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each phrase lands with controlled weight. No room for misunderstanding. The tone is firm but not angry—a boss who trusts competence and expects it in return.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。原材料の、本気で、絶対、急騰、絶対、当社、絶対、対応中、絶対、です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The raw materials surge—we're handling it. Absolutely. I appreciate your confidence in us.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Respectful but not obsequious. The confirmation sits solid; no defensive edge. Slight emphasis on 'handling it' to reassure. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新規取引先を、本気で、絶対、募る、絶対、活動、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Recruit new business partners. Move that forward—I'm serious. This matters.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Slight downward inflection on 'recruit'—it's not a suggestion. Pace is brisk. The closing carries weight without needing to repeat it. A manager who assumes you'll do it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料、本気で、絶対、整然と、絶対、まとめております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've compiled all the documentation systematically. Thank you for your trust.
lines.style: Professional and composed. The word 'systematically' carries a small note of pride—proof of thoroughness. Even rhythm. A report delivered with quiet competence, not showing strain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 経営の、本気で、絶対、名著、絶対、社員に、絶対、勧めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want management classics on the staff reading list. Make that happen.
lines.style: Expectation stated clearly. Not a request. Light pause before 'Make that happen'—lets the instruction settle. The tone carries a note of investment: this matters for the team's development.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内の、本気で、絶対、同好、絶対、会、絶対、活発に、絶対、活動しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our in-house reading group is quite active. We're seeing real engagement.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. A small uptick on 'active'—proof of success. Pace is unhurried. This is good news delivered without overselling it. The close trails slightly, genuinely grateful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本社の、本気で、絶対、真下、絶対、ある、絶対、テナント、絶対、契約状況、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the lease status on the tenant space directly below headquarters. Confirm the details.
lines.style: Specific, procedural. A task assignment from someone used to being understood the first time. Even pace, precise articulation. The closing 'confirm' is firm—this isn't delegated lightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製造ラインの、本気で、絶対、アーム、絶対、ロボット、絶対、刷新、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with the manufacturing line automation upgrade. Progress is steady.
lines.style: Factual update with quiet momentum underneath. 'Automation upgrade' gets clear weight—this is significant. Pace is even and professional. The close is reassuring without being defensive.
